bib.title: AudioPaLM: A Large Language Model That Can Speak and Listen

read.skipped: References skimmed only; the per-language number grid of Tables 14-17 was read as flattened text, not cross-checked cell by cell

question: Can a text-pretrained decoder-only LLM be extended with discrete audio tokens to do speech recognition, speech translation and speech-to-speech translation (with voice preservation) in one model?
hypothesis: Initialising a speech-text model from a text-only LLM transfers text knowledge (notably translation) to speech tasks.
contributions: A unified speech-text LLM that consumes and produces both speech and text, built on PaLM and PaLM-2
Multi-task training over ASR, AST, S2ST giving state of the art on AST and S2ST benchmarks and competitive ASR
S2ST with voice transfer of unseen speakers via AudioLM audio prompting
Zero-shot AST for speech input/target language combinations not seen in training

method.summary: Expand the PaLM / PaLM-2 token embedding matrix (shared with the output softmax) by a block of audio tokens from a w2v-BERT or USM quantiser, finetune all weights on a mixture of ASR, AST, S2ST, TTS, MT tasks marked by text tags such as [S2ST English French], and decode audio tokens to waveform with AudioLM stages 2+3 or SoundStorm.
method.task: Speech recognition, speech translation, speech-to-speech translation, TTS in one decoder-only model

datasets.name: CoVoST2 / CVSS

datasets.source: Wang et al. 2020; Jia et al. 2022c
datasets.preprocessing: CVSS-C used unless stated; CVSS-T for voice transfer eval

datasets.name: VoxPopuli S2ST

datasets.name: Conversational EsEn
datasets.source: crowd-sourced readings of proprietary Spanish-English MT dataset (Jia et al. 2019a)

datasets.name: YouTube ASR
datasets.size: 13k h / 7.6k h / not used in S2ST; 56 languages

datasets.name: WMT/TED TTS
datasets.source: WMT and TED text MT, source and target text run through TTS

datasets.name: PaLM MT TTS
datasets.source: PaLM-2 translated YouTube, Common Voice, Babel transcripts to English; prior AudioPaLM 8B S2ST synthesised speech

datasets.name: FLEURS
datasets.size: 102 languages; 82 used for the All average

models.name: AudioPaLM 8B AST
models.architecture: decoder-only Transformer (PaLM) with expanded embedding matrix
models.vocab: audio vocab 1024 for w2v-BERT and USM-v1; USM-v2 size not stated

models.name: USM encoder (tokenizer)
models.architecture: multilingual speech encoder, middle-layer embeddings k-means quantised

other.USM-v2: trained with auxiliary ASR loss and finetuned further

models.name: SoundStorm / AudioLM stage 2+3
models.architecture: audio token to SoundStream token decoders

other.voice_conditioning: 3 s sample as audio and SoundStream tokens; repeated if shorter

training.objective: next-token prediction with loss masking on inputs
training.lr: 5e-5 constant (PaLM finetune); for PaLM vs PaLM-2 experiment linear ramp-up to 1e-4 then exponential decay to 1e-5
training.lr_schedule: constant 5e-5 (default); ramp-up then exponential decay in Sec 5.4.8

other.setup_ref: same finetuning setup as Section 6.1.2 of Chowdhery et al. 2022
other.all_params_trained: found necessary to train all weights
other.mixture_weights: proportional to dataset size with larger datasets downweighted; SeqIO
other.checkpoint_selection: best AST metric on validation split
other.task_tags: [ASR French], [TTS English], [S2ST English French], combined [ASR AST S2ST English French]

inference.prompting: task tag prefix tokenised with text tokenizer; 3 s voice prompt for voice transfer

other.audio_synthesis: SoundStorm for Table 2 S2ST; AudioLM stage 2+3 for ablations and subjective study

metrics.name: BLEU
metrics.definition: SacreBLEU corpusBLEU, no text normalisation (CoVoST2, FLEURS AST)

metrics.name: WER
metrics.definition: JiWER, case and punctuation ignored; CER for Japanese and Chinese on CoVoST2 ASR

metrics.name: ASR-BLEU
metrics.definition: generated audio transcribed by the Translatotron 2 ASR model, BLEU against ground-truth target text

metrics.name: MOS / SMOS
metrics.definition: 1-5 ratings, 10 ratings per output, 6300 ratings per study; plus no-reference MOS estimator, speaker-verification cosine similarity, same-recording embedding cosine similarity

eval.protocol: test splits; single runs, no seeds or significance tests stated; subjective study on 210 source utterances (10 per language x 21) prefiltered to estimated MOS >= 3.0, run on an earlier AudioPaLM version

evidence.quote: we finetune with the Adafactor optimizer with a constant learning rate of 5 × 10−5 and dropout rate of 0.1, and we use loss masking on the inputs

limits: Strong dependency on audio tokenizer quality (Limitations cites a Section 7 that does not exist; Sec 5.4.3 is the evidence)
Whole model had to be finetuned, unlike Flamingo-style frozen approaches, so no guarantee original text capabilities are preserved
Benchmarks for generative audio tasks are immature; work covers ASR and speech translation only
Subjective voice and quality studies used an earlier model version with AudioLM decoding, not the final SoundStorm model
Batch size, steps, hardware, compute, seeds, context length and layer counts are not stated; model not released
S2ST training lowers AST and ASR quality; ASR is worse than MAESTRO and mSLAM on VoxPopuli
Whisper comparison on FLEURS is not zero-shot for Whisper and uses far more AST data
